name: Simple Sat
note: Primary costume uses the input hue; secondary uses Analog 1; accent uses the complement; hair and eyes share Analog 2.

name: OffWhite
note: Costume primary is a desaturated input-tinted off-white; costume secondary restores the saturated input hue; accent uses the complement.

name: OffBlack
note: Costume primary is a desaturated dark neutral from the input hue; costume secondary restores the saturated input hue; accent uses the complement.

name: PureWhite
note: White costume primary; input hue as secondary; complement as accent; analogous hair and eyes.

name: PureBlack
note: Black costume primary; input hue as secondary; complement as accent; analogous hair and eyes.

name: HairEyesMono WBW
note: Hair and eyes carry the input hue while the costume follows a white-black-white neutral pattern; power uses the complement.

name: HairEyesMono BWB
note: Hair and eyes carry the input hue while the costume follows a black-white-black neutral pattern; power uses the complement.

name: MessySat
note: Colorful analogous costume: input, Analog 1, Analog 2; power is reserved for the complement.

name: Power Monochrome WBWB
note: Power-signature monochrome with a white-black-white-black neutral pattern across primary, secondary, accent, and hair; eyes and power use the input hue.

name: Power Monochrome BWBW
note: Power-signature monochrome with a black-white-black-white neutral pattern across primary, secondary, accent, and hair; eyes and power use the input hue.

name: Square
note: Four-point hue geometry: input, two right-angle hues, and complement.

name: Split Complementary White
note: White costume primary with input secondary, split-complement accent, and second split-complement hair/eyes.

name: Split Complementary Black
note: Black costume primary with input secondary, split-complement accent, and second split-complement hair/eyes.
